name: Arbiter Social Intelligence
description: Social-media case studies: browse already-collected, already-analyzed corpora (curated studies plus studies created with this key) for sentiment, stance, engagement, entity, theme, and archived-post analysis, or create a new study from a reviewed search plan.
sample_agent_questions: Which themes are driving the most engagement right now?
Which accounts are amplifying this narrative the most?
What are the strongest claims and supporting sources?
How did this discussion spike and evolve over time?
Compare this story across platforms and key differences
Where are most of these posts coming from geographically?
rate_limit_note: Per-key rate limit — respect Retry-After on 429. Post pulls, search-plan generation, finalization, and agent questions are credit-metered; listing case studies, entities, themes, reports, creating a pending study, status, progress, and /usage are free. GET /usage reports the remaining balance and the advertised per-minute limit.
